thread:
claire: tagging this thread for the SOC2/ISO auditor ask received this morning. They want RBAC change history, KMS usage events (GenerateDataKey/Decrypt/ReEncrypt/CreateGrant), and an incident example. keeping conversation here.

josh: confirm scope = last 12 months? auditor email ambiguous.

auditor_bot: Primary scope: 12 months. Supplemental archival up to 18 months optional. Deliverables: role->principal->control CSV, cloudtrail KMS exports for the key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789-abcd, manifest.csv with SHA256 hashes, and a signed attestation.

tina: plan: 1) iam-role-changes.csv (aws cloudtrail lookup) 2) k8s-rolebinding-history.csv (k8s audit) 3) kms_events_key-abcd.csv (CloudTrail filtered) 4) cloudtrail_raw.jsonl.gz 5) incident_redacted.zip (IR-2025-11) 6) manifest + README + signed_attestation.txt

josh: quick Q 1 do they want individual service-account names? that might include PII.

auditor_bot: Provide service-account list for high privilege roles. If PII concerns, provide pseudonymized mapping in an encrypted sealed artifact.

people-ops: we prefer pseudonymization. Approve sealed mapping file encrypted with team GPG. Deliver sealed mapping via SFTP only after NDA confirmation.

claire: noted. we'll produce two bundles: public_evidence_bundle.zip (pseudonymized) + sealed_mapping.tar.gpg (SFTP).

josh: commands I'll run for IAM: ```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventCategory,AttributeValue=Management --start-time 2025-04-01 --end-time 2026-04-01 --query 'Events[?contains(EventName, `Role`)]' > /tmp/iam-role-events.json
jq '.[] | {EventTime, EventName, Username: .Username, Resources}' /tmp/iam-role-events.json > /tmp/iam-role-changes.csv
```

tina: KMS Splunk query for reproducibility to include in README: ```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant) requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789-abcd" | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.encryptionContext
```

sec-bot: automated: creating ephemeral role redwood-audit-exporter, TTL 36h. Creation event logged at 2026-04-12T09:10:00Z.

josh: will include a replay script that runs the same aws cloudtrail lookup-events commands and generates the CSV + SHA256 manifest.

claire: incident tie-in: include IR-2025-11 (staging key overpermission). tina, please collect the redacted timeline, cloudtrail snippets showing anomalous decrypts, and the remediation commit. redact user emails.

tina: yes. will include an appendix describing managed-service noise (EBS, RDS) so auditor doesn't confuse service principals with human access.

people-ops: confirm redaction rules: no employee emails, no phone numbers. pseudonyms OK. Signed attestation must include key fingerprint and timestamp.

auditor_bot: PGP-signed attestation acceptable. Include fingerprint and signing time. Manifest.csv should be CSV with filename, sha256, short_description.

claire: delivery options: presigned S3 (7d, SSE-KMS) or secure SFTP. We'll offer both; sealed mapping only via SFTP.

josh: ETA: IAM & CloudTrail extracts by Tue EOD, k8s slices Wed, assemble Thu, upload Fri AM. I'll drop the presigned link in this thread.

sec-bot: note: CloudTrail retention checked  all requested 12 months available. Older archives in Glacier beyond 13 months.

claire: final checklist: iam-role-changes.csv (josh); k8s-rolebinding-history.csv (claire); kms_events_key-abcd.csv (tina); cloudtrail_raw.jsonl.gz (infra export); incident_redacted.zip (tina); manifest.csv + README.md (claire); signed_attestation.pgp.txt (claire); sealed_mapping.tar.gpg (people-ops via SFTP).

claire: thanks team. auditor preference accepted. Posting updates and presigned URL when uploaded.
